newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, investors watch USDA.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, investors watch USDA.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Friday and the market lacked clear direction ahead of the USDA's crop report to be released tonight.
Prices ranged from 70 yen lower to 80 yen higher, with the benchmark January 1998 contract down 70 yen at 14,400. The day's volume was 45,569 lots.

Local investors, who were discouraged by a weaker Chicago market overnight, started selling from the opening, traders said. The selling lost its momentum later, as some investors covered short positions at nearby months, they said. "Nearby months still have many short positions," a trader said.
As of 0825 GMT, the spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A system was last traded at $2.58-1/4 per bushel, unchanged from Thursday's Chicago close.
Spot January CBOT soybean futures on Project A were at $6.95-1/4, down from $6.95-3/4.
